meta_title: VPN Kill Switch: Block Traffic If the VPN Drops | VpnHood!
meta_description: The kill switch blocks your internet connection the moment the VPN disconnects, so nothing leaves the device unprotected. In the VpnHood! apps.
title: Kill Switch
lead: Automatically blocks the internet connection if the VPN disconnects.
shot_alt: The Kill Switch screen in the VpnHood! app
platforms: Android phones and tablets only. It relies on an Android system setting that iOS, Windows and Android TV do not expose.
how_desc: If the tunnel drops, a device would normally fall back to the ordinary connection without telling you. The kill switch blocks traffic instead, so nothing leaves the device unprotected in the gap.
when_desc: Leave it on whenever an accidental unprotected moment matters more to you than staying online.
cost_desc: When the VPN drops you lose connectivity until it is back. That is exactly the trade you are choosing.
